arabic_text: أَلْحَمْدُ للهِ الاوَّلِ بِلا أَوَّل كَانَ قَبْلَهُ، وَ الاخِر بِلاَ آخِر يَكُونُ بَعْدَهُ
transliteration: al-ḥamdu lillāh al-awwali bilā awwal kāna qablahu wa al-ākhir bilā ākhir yakūnu baʿdahu
english_text: Praise belongs to God, the First, without a first before Him, the Last, without a last behind Him.

arabic_text: ،الَّذِي قَصُرَتْ عَنْ رُؤْيَتِهِ أَبْصَارُ النَّاظِرِينَ وَ عَجَزَتْ عَنْ نَعْتِهِ أَوهامُ اَلْوَاصِفِينَ
transliteration: al-ladhi qasurat ʿan ruʾyatih abṣāru al-naẓirīn wa ʿajazat ʿan naʿtihi aw'ham-ul-waṣifīn
english_text: Beholders' eyes fall short of seeing Him, describers' imaginations are not able to depict Him.

arabic_text: ابْتَدَعَ بِقُدْرَتِهِ الْخَلْقَ اَبتِدَاعَاً، وَاخْتَرَعَهُمْ عَلَى مَشِيَّتِهِ اخترَاعاً،
transliteration: ibtada'a bi qudratihi al-khalaqa ibtidā'an wa-ikhtaraʿahum ʿala mashyyatihi ikhtirāʿan
english_text: He originated the creatures through His power with an origination, He devised them in accordance with His will with a devising.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ سَلَكَ بِهِمْ طَرِيقَ إرَادَتِهِ، وَبَعَثَهُمْ فِي سَبِيلِ مَحَبَّتِهِ
transliteration: thumma salaka bihim ṭarīqa ʾirādatihi wa baʿathahum fi sabili mahabbatihi
english_text: Then He made them walk on the path of His desire, He sent them out on the way of His love.

arabic_text: لايَمْلِكُونَ تَأخِيراً عَمَا قَدَّمَهُمْ إليْهِ وَلا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَقَدُّماً إلَى مَا أَخَّرَهُمْ عَنْهُ،
transliteration: lā yamlikūn taʾkhīran ʿan mā qaddamahum ilayh wala yastateeʿoona taqadduman ila ma akhkharahum ʿanhu
english_text: They cannot keep back from that to which He has sent them forward, nor can they go forward to that from which He has kept them back.

arabic_text: وَ جَعَلَ لِكُلِّ رُوْح مِنْهُمْ قُوتَاً مَعْلُوماً مَقْسُوماً مِنْ رِزْقِهِ
transliteration: wa jaʿala li-kulli rūḥin minhum qu-tan ma'luman maq-su-man min riz-qi-hi
english_text: He assigned from His provision to each of their spirits a nourishment known and apportioned.

arabic_text: لاَ يَنْقُصُ مَنْ زادَهُ نَاقِصٌ، وَلاَ يَزِيدُ مَنْ نَقَصَ منْهُمْ زَائِدٌ
transliteration: lā yanqusu man zādahu nāqisun wa lā yazeedu man naqasahum zāʾidun
english_text: No decreaser decreases those whom He increases, no increaser increases those of them whom He decreases.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ ضَرَبَ لَهُ فِي الْحَيَاةِ أَجَلاً مَوْقُوتاً، وَ نَصَبَ لَهُ أَمَداً مَحْدُوداً،
transliteration: thumma ḍaraba lahū fīl-ḥayāti ʾajalan mawqūtan wa naṣaba lahū ʾamadan maḥdūdan
english_text: Then for each spirit He strikes a fixed term in life, for each He sets up a determined end;

arabic_text: يَتَخَطَّأُ إلَيهِ بِأَيَّامِ عُمُرِهِ، وَيَرْهَقُهُ بِأَعْوَامِ دَهْرِهِ،
transliteration: yatakhaththau ilayhi bi-ayyami ʿumurihi wayarhaquhu bi-aʿwami daḥrihi
english_text: he walks toward it through the days of his span, he overtakes it through the years of his time.

arabic_text: حَتَّى إذَا بَلَغَ أَقْصَى أَثَرِهِ، وَ اسْتَوْعَبَ حِسابَ عُمُرِهِ، قَبَضهُ إلَى ما نَدَبَهُ إلَيْهِ مِنْ مَوْفُورِ ثَوَابِهِ أَوْ مَحْذُورِ عِقَابِهِ،
transliteration: ḥattā ʾiḏa balagha ʾaqṣá ʾatharih wa astawʿaba hisaba ʿumurihi qabḍuhu ilā mā nadabahu ilayh min mawfūri thawābihī aw maḥḏūri ʿiqābihī
english_text: Then, when he takes his final step and embraces the reckoning of his span, God seizes him to the abundant reward or the feared punishment to which He has called him,

arabic_text: لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَساءُوا بِمَا عَمِلُوا وَ يَجْزِىَ الَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا بِالْحُسْنَى عَدْلاً مِنْهُ تَقَدَّسَتْ أَسْمَآؤُهُ، وَتَظَاهَرَتْ ألاؤُهُ،
transliteration: liyajziya allaḏīna ʾasāʾū bimā ʿamilū wa yajziya alladhina ahsanu bil husna ʿadlan minhu taqaddasat asmāʾuhu wa taẓāhara al-aʾuha
english_text: "That He may repay those who do evil for what they have done and repay those who do good with goodness" (53:31), as justice from Him (holy are His names, and manifest His boons).

arabic_text: لاَ يُسْأَلُ عَمَّا يَفْعَلُ وَهُمْ يُسْأَلُونَ
transliteration: lā yus'al ʿammā yafʿal wa hum yusʾalūn
english_text: "He shall not be questioned as to what He does, but they shall be questioned" (21:23).

arabic_text: وَالْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي لَوْ حَبَسَ عَنْ عِبَادِهِ مَعْرِفَةَ حَمْدِهِ عَلَى مَا أَبْلاَهُمْ مِنْ مِنَنِهِ الْمُتَتَابِعَةِ وَأَسْبَغَ عَلَيْهِمْ رمِنْ نِعَمِهِ الْمُتَظَاهِرَة لَتَصرَّفُوا فِي مِنَنِهِ فَلَمْ يَحْمَدُوهُ
transliteration: wa-l-ḥamdu lillāhi alladhī law ḥabasa ʿan ʿibādihī maʿrifatahā ḥamdihi ʿalā mā ablahum min minanihi al-mutatābiʿah wa-asbagha ʿalayhim ramin niʿamihi al-mutazahira latasarrufu fi minanihi falam yahmaduhu
english_text: Praise belongs to God, for, had He withheld from His servants the knowledge to praise Him for the uninterrupted kindnesses with which He has tried them and the manifest favours which He has lavished upon them, they would have moved about in His kindnesses without praising Him,

arabic_text: وَتَوَسَّعُوا فِي رِزْقِهِ فَلَمْ يَشْكُرُوهُ،
transliteration: wa tawassaʿū fī rizqihim fa lam yashkurūhu
english_text: and spread themselves out in His provision without thanking Him.

arabic_text: وَلَوْ كَانُوا كَذلِكَ لَخَرَجُوا مِنْ حُدُودِ الانْسَانِيَّةِ إلَى حَدِّ الْبَهِيمِيَّةِ، :فَكَانُوا كَمَا وَصَفَ فِي مُحْكَم كِتَابِهِ ( إنْ هُمْ إلا كَالانْعَامِ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلا )
transliteration: wa law kānū kadhālika lakharajū min ḥudūd al-insāniyyah ʾilā ḥaddi l-bahīmiyyah fakānū kamā waṣafa fī muḥkam kitābihi ('in hum illa ka'l-an'am, bal hum adallu sabila)
english_text: Had such been the case, they would have left the bounds of humanity for that of beastliness and become as He has described in the firm text of His Book: "They are but as the cattle—nay, but they are further astray from the way"! (25:46)

arabic_text: وَالْحَمْدُ لله عَلَى مَا عَرَّفَنا من نفسه وَأَلْهَمَنَا مِنْ شُكْرِهِ وَفَتَحَ لَنَا من أبوَابِ الْعِلْمِ بِرُبُوبِيّته وَدَلَّنَا عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الاِخْلاَصِ لَهُ فِي تَوْحِيدِهِ
transliteration: wa al-ḥamdu lillāh ʿalā mā ʿarrafanā min nafsih wa alhamanā min shukrihī wa fataḥa lanā min abwābi al-ʿilmi bi rubūbiyyatihi wa dallanā ʿalayhi min al-ikhlāṣi lahū fī tawḥīdihī
english_text: Praise belongs to God, for the true knowledge of Himself He has given to us, the thanksgiving He has inspired us to offer Him, the doors to knowing His Lordship He has opened for us, the sincerity towards Him in professing His Unity to which He has led us,

arabic_text: وَجَنَّبَنا مِنَ الالْحَادِ وَالشَّكِّ فِي أَمْرِهِ،
transliteration: wa jannabana mina al-ilhadi wa alshakki fi amrihi
english_text: and the deviation and doubt in His Command from which He has turned us aside;

arabic_text: حَمْداً نُعَمَّرُ بِهِ فِيمَنْ حَمِدَهُ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ وَنَسْبِقُ بِـهِ مَنْ سَبَقَ إلَى رِضَاهُ وَعَفْوِهِ
transliteration: ḥamdān nuʿammaru bihī fīman ḥamidahu min khalqihī wa-nasbiqu bihi man sabaqa ila ridaahi wa'afwih
english_text: a praise through which we may be given long life among those of His creatures who praise Him, and overtake those who have gone ahead toward His good pleasure and pardon;

arabic_text: حَمْداً يُضِيءُ لَنَا بِهِ ظُلُمَاتِ الْبَرْزَخِ وَيُسَهِّلُ عَلَيْنَا بِهِ سَبِيلَ الْمَبْعَثِ وَيُشَرِّفُ بِهِ مَنَازِلَنَا عِنْدَ مَوَاقِفِ الاشْهَادِ يَوْمَ تُجْزَى كُلُّ نَفْس بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لا يُظْلَمُونَ
transliteration: ḥamdan yuḍī'u lanā bihī ẓulumāt al-barzakh wa yusahhilu ʿalayna bihi sabila al-mabʿath wa yusharrafu bihi manazilana 'inda mawaqifi al-ashhad yawma tuʾjzā kullu nafsin bimā kasabat wa hum lā yudhlamūn
english_text: a praise through which He will illuminate for us the shadows of the interworld, ease for us the path of the Resurrection, and raise up our stations at the standing places of the Witnesses "on the day when every soul will be repaid for what it has earned - they shall not be wronged" (45:21);

arabic_text: (يَوْمَ لاَ يُغْنِي مَوْلىً عَنْ مَوْلىً شَيْئاً وَلاَ هُمْ يُنْصَرُونَ)
transliteration: (yawma lā yughnī mawlān ʿan mawlān shayʾan walā hum yunṣarūn)
english_text: "the day a master shall avail nothing a client, and they shall not be helped" (44:41);

arabic_text: حَمْداً يَرْتَفِعُ مِنَّا إلَى أَعْلَى عِلِّيِّينَ فِي كِتَاب مَرْقُوم يَشْهَدُهُ الْمُقَرَّبُونَ، حَمْداً تَقَرُّ بِهِ عُيُونُنَا إذَا بَرِقَت الابْصَارُ وَتَبْيَضُّ بِهِ وُجُوهُنَا إذَا اسْوَدَّتِ الابْشَارُ،
transliteration: ḥamdan yartafiʿu minnā ilā aʿlā ʿilliyyīn fī kitābin marqūm yashhaduhu almuqarrabūn ḥamdān taqarru bihī ʿuyūnunā idhā bariqat al-abṣār wa tabyaddu bihi wujuhuna idha aswaddatil absharu
english_text: a praise which will rise up from us to the highest of the 'Illiyun "in a book inscribed, witnessed by those brought nigh" (83:20-21), a praise whereby our eyes may be at rest when sight is dazzled, our faces whitened when skins are blackened,

arabic_text: حَمْداً نُعْتَقُ بِهِ مِنْ أَلِيمِ نار الله الى كَرِيمِ جِوَارِ اللهِ حَمْداً نُزَاحِمُ بِهِ مَلاَئِكَتَهُ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ وَنُضَامُّ بِـهِ أَنْبِيآءَهُ الْمُـرْسَلِيْنَ
transliteration: ḥamdan nuʿtaqu bihī min ʾalīmi nār allāh ilā karīmi jiwarillāh ḥamdan nuzāḥimu bihi malāʾikatahu al-muqarrabīn wa nuḍāmmu bihi anbiyā'ahul mursalīn
english_text: a praise through which we may be released from God's painful Fire and enter God's generous neighbourhood, a praise by which we may jostle the angels brought nigh and join the prophets, the envoys,

arabic_text: فِي دَارِ الْمُقَامَةِ الَّتِي لا تَزُولُ وَمَحَلِّ كَرَامَتِهِ الَّتِي لاَ تَحُولُ
transliteration: fī dār al-muqāmah allatī lā tazūl wa mahallu karamatihi allati la tahulu
english_text: in a House of Permanence that does not remove, the Place of His Generosity that does not change.

arabic_text: وَالْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي اخْتَارَ لَنَا مَحَاسِنَ الْخَلْقِ وَأَجرى عَلَيْنَا طَيِّبَاتِ الرِّزْقِ وَجَعَلَ لَنَا الفَضِيلَةَ بِالْمَلَكَةِ عَلَى جَمِيعِ الْخَلْقِ
transliteration: wa al-ḥamdu li-llāhi allaḏī akhtāra lanā maḥāsin al-khalq wa'ajraya ʿalayna ṭayyibāti ar-rizq wa jaʿala lana al-faḍilah bil-malakah ʿala jamiʿi al-khalq
english_text: Praise belongs to God, who chose for us the good qualities of creation, granted us the agreeable things of provision, and appointed for us excellence through domination over all creation;

arabic_text: فَكُلُّ خَلِيقَتِهِ مُنْقَادَةٌ لَنَا بِقُدْرَتِهِ، وَصَآئِرَةٌ إلَى طَاعَتِنَا بِعِزَّتِهِ
transliteration: fakullu khalīqatihi munqādah lana bi qudratihi waṣāʾiratun ilā ṭāʿatinā biʿizzatihī
english_text: every one of His creatures submits to us through His power and comes to obey us through His might.

arabic_text: وَالْحَمْدُ لله الَّذِي أَغْلَقَ عَنَّا بَابَ الْحَّاجَةِ إلاّ إلَيْهِ
transliteration: wa al-ḥamdu li-llāhi al-ladhī aghlaqa ʿannā bāba al-ḥājah illā ilayhi
english_text: Praise belongs to God, who locked for us the gate of need except toward Him.

arabic_text: فَكَيْفَ نُطِيقُ حَمْدَهُ أَمْ مَتَى نُؤَدِّي شُكْرَهُ؟ لا، مَتى؟
transliteration: fakayfa nuṭīqu ḥamdahu am matā nuaddī shukrahu? lā, matā?
english_text: So how can we praise Him? When can we thank Him? Indeed, when?

arabic_text: وَالْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي رَكَّبَ فِينَا آلاَتِ الْبَسْطِ وَجَعَلَ لَنَا أدَوَاتِ الْقَبْضِ، وَمَتَّعَنا بِاَرْواحِ الْحَياةِ وَأثْبَتَ فِينَا جَوَارِحَالاعْمَال
transliteration: wa al-ḥamdulillāh alladhī rakkaba fīnā ālāti al-basṭi wa jaʿala lana adawati al-qabḍi wa mattaʿana bi-arwāḥi al-ḥayāh wa-athbata feenaa jawaarih al-a'maal
english_text: Praise belongs to God, who placed within us the organs of expansion, assigned for us the agents of contraction, gave us to enjoy the spirits of life, fixed within us the limbs of works,

arabic_text: وَغَذَّانَا بِطَيِّبَاتِ الرِّزْقِ ، وَأغْنانَا بِفَضْلِهِ وَأقْنانَا بِمَنِّهِ
transliteration: wa-ghaḏḏānā bi-ṭayyibāt al-rizq wa aghnana bi-fadlihi wa aqnanā bi mannihi
english_text: nourished us with the agreeable things of provision, freed us from need through His bounty, and gave us possessions through His kindness.

arabic_text: ثُمّ أَمَرَنَا لِيَخْتَبِرَطاعَتَنَا، وَنَهَانَا لِيَبْتَلِيَ شُكْرَنَا فَخَالَفْنَا عَنْ طَرِيْقِ أمْرِهِ وَرَكِبْنا مُتُونَ زَجْرهِ ِ
transliteration: thumma amarana liyakhtabira ta'atana wa nahanā liyabtalīya shukranā fakhālafnā ʿan ṭarīqi amrihi wa rakibna mutūna zajrihi
english_text: Then He commanded us that He might test our obedience and prohibited us that He might try our thanksgiving. So we turned against the path of His commandments and mounted the backs of His warnings.
